fieldNotes.api: unknown unless a title-specific Windows API source or test is recorded; no API was inferred.
fieldNotes.signInNeeded: null means the per-title requirement is unverified. The shared Xbox account is signed in.
fieldNotes.sizeBytes: Local installed-root byte sum only, not download size; null means no matching local root.
